name: dots-gateway
description: Remote development, Antigravity (agy) & OpenAI Codex (codex) MCP plugin enabling OpenAI dots to inspect/edit local files, execute allowlisted dev commands, and run agy or codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run local dev commands, edit workspace files, and invoke agy via MCP
interface.longDescription: Bridges OpenAI dots to your remote development machine over a hardened TLS 1.3 + HMAC-SHA256 gateway via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Provides atomic workspace file operations (fs_read, fs_write, fs_patch, fs_list), allowlisted shell/build/test execution (exec_command), multi-turn background sessions (session_*), and unattended Antigravity (agy --dangerously-skip-permissions) delegation (run_agy).
defaultPrompt: Check remote gateway status and list projects in the default workspace.
Delegate feature implementation on my remote repo to run_agy and verify with pytest.
Inspect git status and run the test suite on my remote machine via dots-gateway.
